name: Animenia Abu Dhabi
blurb: Five-day immersive anime festival in Abu Dhabi with cosplay competitions, meet & greets, J-pop shows and a gaming zone.
notes: Official site still presents the Feb 11-15, 2026 edition as the current/latest one ('Animenia is back from February 11 to February 15, 2026'); no 2027 dates are announced yet, matching the fixup note. Guests ('Anime Icon Talks', meet & greets) were part of the Feb 2026 edition only, so none are recorded here since there is no upcoming edition to attach them to.
